The pin changes themselves are not in the supplied evidence, so the changelog cannot be checked against them. - Automatic watchdog updates install 0.10.3 about five minutes after a crash. This touches T-043 (the watchdog and rollback authority is the same replaceable binary), but the changelog describes existing behavior and does not change it.
- The MLX submodule pin change is a supply-chain surface (T-034, T-013). It needs review in the actual submodule or pin commits, not in this changelog.

No threat-model assumptions are invalidated by this change, and T-041 and the other supplied definitions are unaffected.
